facts.business: Kratikal Tech Limited operates in India's IT-BPM and cybersecurity industry, offering a scaled multi-vertical platform comprising People Security Management (Threatcop) and Technology & Process Security Services (AutoSecT) to address human-layer and infrastructure-layer cyber risk.
key_risks: Customer concentration (Top 10 clients at 31.60% of FY26 revenue)
Forex and geopolitical exposure from exports
Higher receivable levels (turnover ratio down from 6.43x to 5.66x)
